services.name: Full-Time Nanny
services.tagline: Consistent daily care from a vetted nanny
services.description: A trusted, full-time caregiver who becomes part of your family's rhythm. Our nannies are background-checked, CPR-certified, and matched to your family's values and schedule. Typical placements are 30–45 hours per week.
services.bookingNotes: Minimum 30 hours/week. We recommend starting with an in-home interview and a paid trial day to make sure the fit is right.

services.name: Part-Time Nanny
services.tagline: Reliable, flexible coverage without the full-time commitment
services.description: Steady weekday or weekend hours from the same vetted nanny, ideal for families who need consistent care on a part-time schedule. Same screening and credential verification as full-time placements.
services.bookingNotes: Typical placements are 10–25 hours/week, fixed or flexible. Start with an interview + paid trial.

services.name: Date Night Care
services.tagline: A reliable sitter for the nights that matter
services.description: Evening sitters who arrive on time, follow your routine, and let you actually enjoy your night out. Every date-night provider is vetted to the same standard as our full-time nannies.
services.bookingNotes: Book at least 48 hours in advance. Minimum 3-hour booking. Same-day requests subject to availability.

services.name: Travel Nanny
services.tagline: A trusted nanny who travels with your family
services.description: For vacations, weddings, business trips, and holiday gatherings, bring a familiar, vetted caregiver along so you can be present for the moments that matter.
services.bookingNotes: Book at least 2 weeks in advance.

services.name: One-Off Care
services.description: Occasional or emergency child care for sick days, last-minute meetings, school holidays, and weekend errands. The same vetted providers, scheduled in shorter blocks.
services.bookingNotes: 12-hour notice preferred and subject to availability. We'll always confirm before sending a provider.

categories.name: Other Services
categories.tagline: More ways we care for your family

services.name: Mother's Helper
services.tagline: Household help while you're home with the kids
services.description: An extra set of hands for the day: light tidying, laundry, meal prep, errands, and play with older children while you handle the baby or take a break. Mother's helpers do not provide unsupervised child care.
services.bookingNotes: Sessions are scheduled around your needs, with no minimum commitment. Reach out and we'll find a helper who fits your family's pace.

services.name: Tutoring
services.tagline: One-on-one academic support from vetted tutors
services.description: Reading, math, writing, study skills, and test prep, all delivered in your home by background-checked tutors matched to your child's grade level and subject. Same vetting standard as our nanny roster.
services.bookingNotes: Typical sessions are 1–2 hours, weekly or as-needed. Subject and grade-level match confirmed before the first session.

services.name: Drop-In Pet Visit
services.tagline: Walks, feeds, and check-ins while you're away
services.description: Scheduled visits to your home: walks, feeding, fresh water, medication, litter, and a photo update each visit. Perfect for day trips or work travel.

services.name: Overnight Pet Sitting
services.tagline: A trusted sitter stays with your pet while you're away
services.description: Your pet stays home, sticking to their normal routine, with one of our vetted sitters staying overnight. Includes morning and evening walks/feeds, fresh water, medication, and daily photo updates.
services.bookingNotes: Minimum 2-night booking. Book 1+ week in advance when possible. House sitting services such as getting mail, watering plants, etc, can be added for an additional fee.
